B0.source: Ng 2022 SII B p.2 (interval = 29.09733(4) GHz); Ng thesis S4.1.1 p.78
B0.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: 0.01 MHz; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified. Interval/4 approximation, not a refit with D0 and extra hyperfine terms. Propagated measurement uncertainty is 0.010 MHz. With the current B J(J+1)-D[J(J+1)]^2 terms, the rotational interval is 4B-32D, 124.704 kHz below the source interval; a consistent refit is unresolved

D0.source: Gresh 2016 Table 1, X3Delta1 D'' column (1.30(4)e-7 cm-1)
D0.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: 0.12 kHz; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified.

omega_ef.source: Ng 2022 Table I p.5; Ng thesis Table 4.1 p.87
omega_ef.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: 0.05 MHz; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified.

A_par.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: 0.1 MHz; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified. may absorb 2 c_I .. 6 c_I ~ 40-120 kHz of unmodelled nuclear spin-rotation -- [HAM] S2.6, OPEN-6

c_I.source: [HAM] S2.6: B&C Table 8.12 c2(19F, CsF) = 15.1 kHz at B_v = 0.183782 cm-1, scaled linearly in B
c_I.note: Order-of-magnitude analogy only. The 15.1 kHz CsF anchor gives 19.94 kHz after B scaling; neither the ThF+ sign nor a factor-of-three error bound is established. CsF is closed-shell; ThF+ is open-shell. B&C printed p.421/PDF p.453 discusses opposite-sign first/second-order contributions. Sweep this parameter rather than treating 20 kHz as a precision prediction

d_mf.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: 0.09 D; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified. ORIGIN-DEPENDENT for an ion: 2.74 D w.r.t. the Th nucleus (Skripnikov & Titov 2015 Table II) = 3.46 D at c.m.

G_zz.source: Ng thesis p.87 (0.048(2) for g_F < 0) as the measured sum: G_zz = 0.04756 - G_perp, which keeps |g_F=3/2| = 0.0149 (Ng 2022) exact -- [HAM] S3
G_zz.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: 0.002 ; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified. G_zz IS Ng's G_par. sign of g_F is NOT measured; theory forces g_F < 0. OPEN-4. The datum constrains G_zz + G_perp only, so the split between this value and G_xx/G_yy is Petrov's, not measured; the 0.6 % difference from the old G_par = 0.04756 sits well inside the +-0.002

G_xx.source: G_perp + G_Delta with G_perp = 1.02769e-3 and G_Delta = -2.0558e-4 from the second-order sums of Petrov & Skripnikov arXiv:2503.02840 Eqs. (3)-(15); docs/lit/lookup-effective-zeeman-tensor.md S2, S4
G_xx.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: none quantified; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified. ESTIMATE, not a measurement: second-order perturbation theory, ~20 % on G_Delta. G_Delta = (G_xx - G_yy)/2 < 0 is the parity-dependent part; it ADDS to the e level's g-factor, the component that mixes with the Omega = 0+ states (1Sigma+, 3Pi_0+). OPEN-10

G_yy.source: G_perp - G_Delta with G_perp = 1.02769e-3 and G_Delta = -2.0558e-4 from the second-order sums of Petrov & Skripnikov arXiv:2503.02840 Eqs. (3)-(15); docs/lit/lookup-effective-zeeman-tensor.md S2, S4
G_yy.note: Transferred unchanged from 232Th19F+ to 227Th19F+; not measured for the target isotope and not mass-scaled. Source-isotope uncertainty: none quantified; target-isotope transfer uncertainty is unquantified. ESTIMATE, not a measurement: second-order perturbation theory, ~20 % on G_Delta. See G_xx

g_N.source: 19F nuclear g-factor, Petrov et al. arXiv:1704.06631 Eq. 3

E_eff.source: Ng thesis Eq. C.8 discussion p.322 (JILA adopts ~35); Skripnikov & Titov 2015 give 37.3(7 %), Denis 2015 35.2
E_eff.note: OPEN-14: 35.2 vs 37.3 GV/cm. Uncertainty is the quoted +-7 % of the adopted value (2.45 GV/cm), not a spread over the three calculations

W_TP.note: uncertainty is that quoted +-7 % of 50 kHz

d_e.note: electron EDM in e.cm; 0 turns the PT-odd block off

k_TP.note: scalar-pseudoscalar coupling, dimensionless; 0 turns it off

A_par_Th.source: Minkov et al. PRC110 034327 (2024), Table IV
A_par_Th.note: mu=-.0860 mu_N, I=.5; g=mu/I, A=(-10408 MHz)*g. Nuclear-model uncertainty unquantified; no Coriolis/collective mixing correction.

c_I_Th.note: [TH] S4.6 brackets it at ~1 kHz to ~1 MHz, as for 229Th. OPEN-19

g_N_Th.source: Minkov et al. PRC110 034327 (2024), Table IV
g_N_Th.note: mu=-.0860 mu_N, I=.5; g=mu/I, A=(-10408 MHz)*g. Nuclear-model uncertainty unquantified; no Coriolis/collective mixing correction.
